goal: FG-416: Tests sit in the model tree and shards run whole subtrees

components.summary: Collects exact pytest ids, runs bounded parallel shards and reports each test's outcome.
responsibilities: partition the collected tests into whole test-tree subtrees and run every collected test exactly once
record per-test seconds for the next balance
state: .flowguard/cache/test-durations.json: test file digests and per-node seconds
side_effects: runs pytest shards; writes run-local cache
atomically writes .flowguard/cache/test-durations.json after completed test runs

components.summary: Read map and target files, model contracts, static rules and finite ports through shared source parsers.
responsibilities: load, validate and save the map, fingerprints and current-model digests; memoize only parsed contracts by source identity
resolve component parents in one layer without loops
merge the target overlay, validate its remove intents and compare it with current
compute component fingerprints that detect stale descriptions
register contract models and build the model tree with its nesting errors
count import-like strings and injected attribute calls as dependency evidence
name every removed path, literal, flag and public name in one table

remove: responsibility:shard tests by exact node id and run every shard on each invocation
responsibility:verify each collected test ran exactly once in the release whole-suite phase
